answer: Non-Transferable Reputation Escrow. Each identity's earned score sits in a terrace of locked tiers; to spawn a clone, an attacker must re-earn every tier from zero, since scores cannot be copied or sold. Withdrawal of rewards requires a jade seal tied to continuous history, so fresh clones earn nothing until they age. Migration across pools is logged on a shared reef ledger, capping how many new identities one operator can warm per epoch. Cost: the full re-earning time per clone, not just a fee.
